## LinearKinkIrm #2

Inverts the market-is-configured check, so a rate query reverts for a configured market and runs for an unconfigured one.

- **Mutant:** [`2.sol`](2.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rvLkiBorrowRateRevertsIffConfigNotSet`](../../specs/LinearKinkIrm/LinearKinkIrm_properties.spec#L413) · [`rvLkiBorrowRateViewRevertsIffConfigNotSet`](../../specs/LinearKinkIrm/LinearKinkIrm_properties.spec#L426)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh LinearKinkIrm 2`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/LinearKinkIrm/properties.conf --rule rvLkiBorrowRateRevertsIffConfigNotSet rvLkiBorrowRateViewRevertsIffConfigNotSet`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkIrm.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkIrm.sol
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@
     ///   U >  optimalUtilization: baseRate + slope1 + slope2 * (U - optimalUtilization) / (WAD - optimalUtilization)
     function _borrowRate(Id id, Market memory market) private view returns (uint256) {
         LinearKinkParams memory p = marketKinkParams[id];
-        require(p.optimalUtilization != 0, ErrorsLib.CONFIG_NOT_SET);
+        require(p.optimalUtilization == 0, ErrorsLib.CONFIG_NOT_SET);

         uint256 utilization =
             market.totalSupplyAssets > 0 ? uint256(market.totalBorrowAssets).wDivDown(market.totalSupplyAssets) : 0;
```

## LinearKinkIrm #3

Prices the below-kink leg with the steeper second slope, so the curve jumps at the kink.

- **Mutant:** [`3.sol`](3.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`hlLkiRateContinuousAtKink`](../../specs/LinearKinkIrm/LinearKinkIrm_properties.spec#L89)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh LinearKinkIrm 3`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/LinearKinkIrm/properties.conf --rule hlLkiRateContinuousAtKink`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkIrm.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkIrm.sol
@@ -84,7 +84,7 @@
         if (utilization > WAD) utilization = WAD;

         if (utilization <= p.optimalUtilization) {
-            return p.baseRate + uint256(p.slope1).wMulDown(utilization.wDivDown(p.optimalUtilization));
+            return p.baseRate + uint256(p.slope2).wMulDown(utilization.wDivDown(p.optimalUtilization));
         } else {
             uint256 excess = (utilization - p.optimalUtilization).wDivDown(WAD - p.optimalUtilization);
             return uint256(p.baseRate) + p.slope1 + uint256(p.slope2).wMulDown(excess);
```

```diff
@@ -86,7 +86,7 @@
         if (utilization <= p.optimalUtilization) {
             return p.baseRate + uint256(p.slope1).wMulDown(utilization.wDivDown(p.optimalUtilization));
         } else {
-            uint256 excess = (utilization - p.optimalUtilization).wDivDown(WAD - p.optimalUtilization);
+            uint256 excess = (utilization + p.optimalUtilization).wDivDown(WAD - p.optimalUtilization);
```

```diff
             market.totalSupplyAssets > 0 ? uint256(market.totalBorrowAssets).wDivDown(market.totalSupplyAssets) : 0;
```

```diff
     }
```

## LinearKinkIrm #3004

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkIrm.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkIrm.sol
@@ -81,7 +81,7 @@
             market.totalSupplyAssets > 0 ? uint256(market.totalBorrowAssets).wDivDown(market.totalSupplyAssets) : 0;
         // Utilization cannot exceed 100% in Morpho. Clamping defends the rate math against adversarial view inputs and
         // caps the returned rate at the curve's peak.
-        if (utilization > WAD) utilization = WAD;
+        require(market.totalBorrowAssets <= market.totalSupplyAssets, "utilization above one");

```

```diff
         if (utilization > WAD) utilization = WAD;
```

```diff
             return p.baseRate + uint256(p.slope1).wMulDown(utilization.wDivDown(p.optimalUtilization));
```
